selections.rationale: Won an Ascot bumper last November and returned to win a Ffos Las 2m soft-ground novice hurdle 30 days ago, finishing strongly; course experience and successful hurdle debut are positives. Trainer Joe Tizzard and rider Dylan Johnston named, and equal 11st5lb to main opponent Katarcice.
selections.main_risks: Significant step up from 2m to 2m5f and switch from soft to good/good-to-firm; Katarcice has proven 2m5f good-ground handicap form and recent Warwick second, while Vedivici is unexposed.

selections.main_risks: Unproven on today's good ground and returns after 225 days; Affordale Fury has Grade 1 winning form (OR 167) and Jagwar is progressive, so no certainty.
